'''Lok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed at [[Frostwake Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he distributed [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] and medical supplies to other Imperial forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Officer Lok appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Stims Vendor for Imperial players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
